Package ca.team.originkickoff.services

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
ca.team.originkickoff.services.NotificationService
public class NotificationService extends Object
Service for managing user notifications stored in Firestore. Provides list retrieval (with index fallback), real‑time listening, mutation, and creation helpers.

    • getNotificationsForUser

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<NotificationItem>> getNotificationsForUser(@NonNull String userId)
      Get all notifications for a user ordered by creation time descending. Falls back to client‑side sorting if a composite index is missing.
      Parameters:
      userId - Firestore user identifier
      Returns:
      Task resolving with a list (possibly empty) of notifications

    • listenNotificationsForUser

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenNotificationsForUser(@NonNull String userId, @NonNull Consumer<List<NotificationItem>> onUpdate, @NonNull Consumer<Exception> onError)
      Attach a real‑time listener for notifications belonging to a user. Results are client‑side sorted descending by createdAt.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      onUpdate - consumer invoked with latest list of notifications
      onError - consumer invoked on listener error
      Returns:
      Firestore listener registration (caller should remove when no longer needed)

    • createLotteryNotification

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> createLotteryNotification(@NonNull String userId, @NonNull String eventId, @NonNull String eventName, boolean isWinner)
      Create and persist a lottery result notification for a user.
      Parameters:
      userId - target user identifier
      eventId - related event identifier
      eventName - human‑readable event name for message composition
      isWinner - whether the user won the lottery
      Returns:
      Task resolving when notification is stored

    • notifyWaitingListEntrants

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> notifyWaitingListEntrants(@NonNull List<String> userIds, @NonNull String eventId, @NonNull String eventName, @Nullable String title, @Nullable String message)
      Broadcast a custom organizer message to waiting-list entrants (active state) for an event. Each notification has type 'waitlist_broadcast'.
      Parameters:
      userIds - active waiting list user IDs
      eventId - event identifier
      eventName - event display name
      title - notification title (fallback applied if blank)
      message - body text (fallback applied if blank)
      Returns:
      Task resolving when all notifications are written
